color-system.twistDescription: Copied exactly as-is — no modification. Color register filter: light (navBackground #ffffff, luminance 255 > 190). stripe qualifies.

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter spacing injection at intensity 3 — added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em to all heading elements. Helvetica Neue (not in Google Fonts) replaced with Archivo. Inter retained as body/logo font via Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling (slower) at intensity 2 — all durations multiplied by 1.3×. fast: 0.098s→0.127s, base: 0.195s→0.254s, slow: 0.325s→0.423s, video: 0.650s→0.845s. More deliberate, measured pacing.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Container max-width expanded from 950px to 1440px (intensity 3) — more immersive, full editorial scale. Padding and breakpoints unchanged.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Global scale factor ×1.35 at intensity 3 — all numeric spacing values scaled up. Section margins: 279→377px, button padding: 15→20px, container padding: 50→68px. More generous breathing room throughout.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist D: Hover opacity at intensity 3 — opacity: 0.75 added to hover states for all links, cards, and navigation elements. Transition durations aligned to motion system (0.127s). No color values changed.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Nav typography size decreased from 1.4rem to 1.3125rem (−0.0875rem at intensity 3). Proprietary font '__myFont_2f1432' replaced with 'Archivo' from assembled type system (Check C nav font fix). Theatrical overlay dropdown removed in favor of clean fixed nav.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift — rewrite of Typography System paragraph to add specific physical materiality detail. Jan Jansen's craft narrative recontextualized for a technical/infrastructure brand register. concept_by_video.md generated fresh with 3 video placements.

consistencyChecks.checkA_colorContrast: PASS — bodyText #000000 vs pageBackground #ffffff: sufficient contrast. navText #000000 vs navBackground transparent (→#ffffff): sufficient. navTextScrolled #000000 vs navBackgroundScrolled transparent (→#ffffff): sufficient.
consistencyChecks.checkB_motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — hover transitions (0.127s–0.2s) and motion system durations (0.127s–0.845s) are within expected range; no >5× mismatch between interactive and scroll animation durations.
consistencyChecks.checkC_navFontAvailability: FIXED — buttermax nav originally used proprietary '__myFont_2f1432' not in assembled typography. Replaced with 'Archivo' which is present in assembled type system fontFaces.
